name: ONTR onlyOwner passes for anyone once ownership is renounced
summary: The ONTR token's Ownable.onlyOwner reads require(owner == address(0) || owner == msg.sender), so after the launcher renounced ownership in the deployment transaction every caller passed it. The attacker's constructor called transferOwnership(itself), queued a 1e12 ONTR grant with the owner-only desertJasper(), credited it with glenFlash() (a balance write with no mint event), transferred the 1e12 ONTR into the ONTR/WETH pair, bypassing the token's sell restrictions as owner, and swapped out 49.48 of the pair's 50.05 WETH.
notes: The token is an obfuscated launch template (renamed OpenZeppelin parts, a hidden owner-only balance grant desertJasper/glenFlash that emits no Transfer, and a sell filter that only lets the owner, granted addresses and the pair move tokens). It is admitted because the loss came from a defect any caller could use: the launcher contract 0x1cffd81d renounced ownership inside the deployment transaction, and onlyOwner treats owner == address(0) as a pass. The attacker EOA 0xe806b37a was funded 57 blocks earlier by 0x12d66f87 and sent the proceeds to 0xc83e7e1d; no link to the deployer 0x325e0a53 was found, and the deployer afterwards removed what was left of its liquidity (0.52 WETH, block 25193535).

Reset is the deployment (block 25192445), which also set the zero owner; the only later writes before the anchor are two small buys. No earlier exploit: the only OwnershipTransferred events are the deployment's and the anchor's, and the anchor is the pair's first WETH outflow.
Loss is the pair's WETH outflow in the anchor (49.48 WETH, $98,553.19 by loss.mjs). Almost all of it was the deployer's 50 WETH seed liquidity; buyers had added about 0.03 WETH before the anchor.
